tests.details: Parsed ModbusTcpGatewaySync and alias with 10 registered bindings: ['%M317', '%M318', '%R1360', '%R1361', '%R1362', '%R1363', '%R1364', '%R1365', '%R1366', '%R1367'].
MBAP 7-byte framing, protocol ID 0x0000, and ADU serialization/deserialization verified.
Pool capacity of 16 clients, disconnect, and reconnect lifecycles verified.
Client pool overflow above 16 trapped deterministically with 0xC801 and fail-safe coil trips.
FIFO request queue, monotonic transaction ID tracking, and client socket matching verified.
Virtual routing between local Horner OCS memory image and downstream device holding registers verified.
Nominal round-trip latency (1.5 ms -> 15) and socket timeout (> 50.0 ms -> 0xC802) verified.
Malformed MBAP frames (0xC803) and unreachable/offline Unit IDs (0xC804) trapped cleanly.
ILogicUnit scan execution, manual operator reset handshake, and memory synchronization verified.
